title: Verify that a Site Content Editor can access and publish the Social Media Icons section directly

steps.action: Configure a new icon entry and attempt to Publish.

steps.action: Load the live Home page (after standard cache refresh).
steps.expected: YouTube icon appears in the Home page section at position 6.

title: Verify that an Editor can edit an existing icon's image, URL, and order and see the change reflected live

title: Verify that an Author-drafted icon becomes live only after Editor approval and publish

steps.action: Load the live Home page.
steps.expected: Flickr icon now appears on the live Home page.

steps.action: Load the live Home page.

title: Verify that a Social Media Icons section load failure does not affect the rest of the Home page

steps.action: Interact with other Home page sections (e.g., Latest News, header navigation).
steps.expected: All other Home page sections render and function normally.

title: Verify that a CMS user without permission cannot persist changes to a social icon entry even via a direct action

title: Verify that an icon cannot be published while Active=True but its Platform URL is invalid
description: Field-dependency case — Active Status and Platform URL validity interact at publish time.

steps.action: Open Add Icon form.
steps.expected: Form opens.

steps.action: Set Active Status = True, but leave Platform URL invalid (e.g., empty or malformed).
steps.expected: Active toggle is set to True; URL field shows invalid/empty state.

steps.action: Attempt to click Publish.
steps.expected: Publish is blocked with the URL validation error; the entry cannot go live in this state.

title: Verify that a valid positive Display Order value saves and reflects the icon's frontend position
description: Display Order = 1.

steps.action: Open Add Icon form.
steps.expected: Form opens.

steps.action: Enter Display Order = 1.
steps.expected: Value entered.

steps.action: Complete remaining fields, save, and publish.
steps.expected: Entry saves with Display Order = 1 and the icon renders first in the row on the live page.

title: Verify that a Display Order value of zero is rejected
description: Display Order = 0.

steps.action: Open Add Icon form.
steps.expected: Form opens.

steps.action: Enter Display Order = 0.
steps.expected: Value entered.

steps.action: Click Save.
steps.expected: Save is blocked; error "Display Order must be a positive number." is shown.

title: Verify that a negative Display Order value is rejected
description: Display Order = -1.

steps.action: Open Add Icon form.
steps.expected: Form opens.

steps.action: Enter Display Order = -1.
steps.expected: Value entered.

steps.action: Click Save.
steps.expected: Save is blocked; error "Display Order must be a positive number." is shown.

title: Verify that a non-numeric Display Order value is rejected
description: Display Order = "abc".

steps.action: Open Add Icon form.
steps.expected: Form opens.

steps.action: Enter Display Order = "abc".
steps.expected: Field either blocks non-numeric keystrokes or accepts and flags on save.

steps.action: Click Save.
steps.expected: Save is blocked; validation error indicates a numeric value is required.

steps.expected: Save succeeds.

steps.expected: Page reloads.

steps.expected: Entry still shows Display Order = 3.

title: Verify that setting Active Status = True on a new entry saves correctly
description: New entry, Active Status toggled to True.

steps.action: Open Add Icon form.
steps.expected: Form opens with a default Active Status state.

steps.action: Set Active Status = True.
steps.expected: Toggle shows True.

steps.action: Complete remaining fields and click Save.
steps.expected: Entry saves with Active Status = True.

title: Verify that setting Active Status = False on a new entry saves correctly and excludes it once published
description: New entry, Active Status toggled to False.

steps.action: Open Add Icon form.
steps.expected: Form opens.

steps.action: Set Active Status = False.
steps.expected: Toggle shows False.

steps.action: Complete remaining fields, save, and publish.
steps.expected: Entry saves and publishes with Active Status = False.

steps.action: Load the live Home page.
steps.expected: Icon does not appear in the live Home page section.

title: Verify that a saved Active Status toggle persists after reload

steps.expected: Save succeeds.

steps.action: Reload the CMS entry list/page.
steps.expected: Page reloads.

steps.action: Reopen the entry.
steps.expected: Entry still shows Active Status = False.

title: Verify that Active Status = True has no frontend effect while the entry's workflow status is not Published
description: Field-dependency case — Active Status and content lifecycle status interact.

steps.action: Create a new icon entry with Active Status = True but only Save (do not Publish, leaving it in Draft).
steps.expected: Entry saves with status Draft, Active = True.

steps.action: Load the live Home page.
steps.expected: Icon does not appear on the live Home page.

steps.action: Return to CMS and confirm entry status.
steps.expected: Entry is confirmed as Draft — Active Status alone does not surface unpublished content.

title: Verify that a Draft-status icon with Active Status = True is not displayed on the frontend
description: Object×status invalid combination — workflow status must gate display, not the Active flag alone.

steps.action: Create an icon entry, set Active Status = True, and Save only (leave in Draft, do not Publish).
steps.expected: Entry saves as Draft.

steps.action: Load the live Home page.
steps.expected: Icon is absent from the live page.

steps.action: Confirm the entry's status in CMS.
steps.expected: CMS confirms status = Draft, Active = True — no leak to production.

title: Verify that toggling the last remaining active+published icon to Inactive hides the entire section, not just the icon
description: Section-level boundary — only one icon is currently live.

steps.action: Ensure exactly one icon entry is Published + Active=True; unpublish/deactivate all others.
steps.expected: Precondition confirmed (1 active icon).

steps.action: Set that last remaining icon's Active Status to False and publish.
steps.expected: Save/publish succeeds.

steps.action: Load the live Home page.
steps.expected: The entire Social Media Icons section (heading, subtext, container) is absent from the page, not an empty row.

title: Verify that two icons sharing the same Display Order value render without breaking the icon row layout
description: Concurrent/duplicate configuration edge — "Facebook" and "LinkedIn" both set to Display Order = 2.

steps.action: Configure "Facebook" with Display Order = 2 and publish.
steps.expected: Facebook entry saves at order 2.

steps.action: Configure "LinkedIn" with Display Order = 2 and publish.
steps.expected: LinkedIn entry saves at order 2 (system allows or flags the duplicate per its own rule).

steps.action: Load the live Home page.
steps.expected: Both icons render in the row in a stable, non-overlapping, non-broken layout regardless of tie-break order.

title: Verify that a Rejected icon entry does not appear on the frontend
description: Recovery/negative status edge — Author submits, Editor rejects.

steps.action: As Author, submit a new "Telegram" entry for review.
steps.expected: Entry saves as Pending Review.

steps.action: As Editor, open the Pending Review entry and click Reject.
steps.expected: Entry status changes to Rejected.

steps.action: Load the live Home page.
steps.expected: Telegram icon does not appear anywhere on the live Home page.

title: Verify that an icon whose external Platform URL is broken still renders and still attempts navigation from QC's side
description: Relation edge between icon config and an unreachable external target — scoped strictly to QC's own behavior per the PBI.

steps.action: Configure and publish an icon with a Platform URL that no longer resolves on the target platform (e.g., a deleted external page).
steps.expected: Entry saves and publishes normally.

steps.action: Load the live Home page.
steps.expected: Icon renders identically to any other active icon — no broken-link indicator on QC's page.

steps.action: Click the icon.
steps.expected: A new tab opens and navigates to the exact configured URL; whatever the external platform returns (e.g., its own 404) is out of QC's control and not asserted here.

title: Verify that an interrupted publish action does not leave a corrupted or partially-saved icon entry
description: Interrupted-transition edge — simulated network drop mid-publish.

steps.action: Open Add Icon form and complete all mandatory fields.
steps.expected: Form is fully completed.

steps.action: Click Publish and immediately interrupt the network connection before the response returns.
steps.expected: Publish request is interrupted; UI shows a failure/timeout state, not a false success.

steps.action: Restore connectivity and check the entry's state in the CMS list.
steps.expected: Entry either does not exist, or exists in a consistent pre-publish state (e.g., Draft) — no entry with missing mandatory fields or a corrupted status is present.

title: Verify that deleting the last active icon entry hides the section gracefully with no layout break
description: Recovery/boundary edge — deletion instead of deactivation reaching the same section-hidden state.

steps.action: Ensure exactly one icon entry is Published + Active=True.
steps.expected: Precondition confirmed.

steps.action: Delete that entry from the CMS.
steps.expected: Entry is removed from the CMS list with a success confirmation.

steps.action: Load the live Home page.
steps.expected: The Social Media Icons section is cleanly absent from the Home page; no empty container, broken grid, or layout shift artifact remains.
